  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Item&#8201;8.01 Other Events</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Vylor Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221; or &#8220;Vylor&#8221;) previously filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;) a registration statement on Form 10, initially filed on June 29, 2026 (as amended on August 14, 2026, September 15, 2026 and September 21, 2026, the &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;), relating to the separation (the &#8220;Spin-Off&#8221;) of the Company from Corteva, Inc. (&#8220;Corteva&#8221;), to be effected by a pro rata dividend of all of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of Vylor (&#8220;Vylor Common Stock&#8221;) to holders of record of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of Corteva (&#8220;Corteva Common Stock&#8221;) as of the close of business on September 24, 2026 (the &#8220;Distribution&#8221;).</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On September 24, 2026, the Registration Statement was declared effective by the SEC. The Registration Statement includes a preliminary information statement that describes the Spin-Off and provides important information regarding the Company&#8217;s business and management. The final information statement, dated September 24, 2026 (the &#8220;Information Statement&#8221;), is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">As further described in the Information Statement, the Spin-Off is expected to occur prior to 9:30 a.m., New York City time, on October 1, 2026 (the &#8220;Distribution Date&#8221;). Each holder of record of Corteva Common Stock as of the close of business on September 24, 2026 will be entitled to receive one share of Vylor Common Stock on the Distribution Date for every share of Corteva Common Stock held of record as of such time. The Distribution is subject to the satisfaction or waiver of certain conditions described in the Information Statement.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Company expects Vylor Common Stock to begin trading on the NYSE under the symbol &#8220;VYLR&#8221; on October 1, 2026.</span></p></div>
